info.description: A key statistic for the Stat Counters section (e.g. '24 disciplines', '5 coaches').

content-manager.label: Stat Value
content-manager.description: The number or text shown in large format, e.g. "24" or "500+".

content-manager.label: Stat Label
content-manager.description: Short descriptor shown beneath the number, e.g. "Disciplines", "Expert Coaches", "Members trained".

content-manager.label: Prefix
content-manager.description: Text before the number, e.g. "Over" or "~".

content-manager.label: Suffix
content-manager.description: Text after the number, e.g. "+" or "classes".

content-manager.label: Sort Order
content-manager.description: Lower numbers appear first in listings. Items with the same number are sorted alphabetically.
